verdict: Leads surged this week, but key launch milestones remain overdue.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 7 leads from Meta at a cost per lead of $74.37, with the most recent week showing a 500% jump in leads and a 70% drop in cost per lead compared to the week prior — a strong early signal. That improvement was largely spend-driven, and with only 17 days of ad history behind it, it's still too early to call this the steady-state cost per lead. Separately, several planned launch items — including Google Search, LSA, and site and landing pages — were due in late July and remain unconfirmed live, which means a meaningful portion of your program is not yet running. We are actively working to clear those blockers so the full plan can go live. Once those channels are running, your lead volume and attribution picture will be materially more complete.
